rationale: The pinned source and relocated dossier hashes were verified, all 46 dependencies and checks C01-C12 were reviewed, and the target's displayed inequality matches Equation (2.23) exactly on nonempty instances with finite exponential moments. It preserves positive lam, joint independence, the one-sided inclusive event, exp(-lam t), and the product of individual MGFs. It does not preserve the full source proposition: it drops the inherited mean-zero, sub-exponential, t ≥ 0, and implicit N ≥ 1 conditions, while adding finite exponential-integrability hypotheses that exclude large-lam source cases with infinite MGFs. Thus neither full statement implies the other and the classification is not-faithful-different. Adjudication remains necessary because the source does not specify the extended-value arithmetic intended when an MGF is infinite.
